title: IBAMA infraction notices (Autos de Infração), Brazil

source.license_note: IBAMA open data; cite the source when reusing

series.name: notices
series.description: Number of infraction notices issued in the month (non-cancelled)

series.name: fine_total_brl
series.description: Total value of fines issued in the month (non-cancelled), in Reais: values in earlier currencies are converted at the official rate of each currency reform (no inflation adjustment)

domain: IBAMA, Brazil's federal environmental agency, publishes every infraction notice (auto de infracao) it issues. Each record is one notice, dated when it was issued, with the fine value when a fine applies.

categories.PDC: Policy-Driven Change: legislation, mandate, agency restructuring or political transition
categories.SP: Seasonal Pattern: a recurring annual enforcement cycle
categories.DQE: Data-Quality Event: reporting failure, system migration, backlog, duplication or retroactive correction
categories.GES: Genuine Enforcement Shift: a real change in enforcement intensity not explained by the above
